title: OL-CONSOLIDATE-LIFECYCLE: merge the parallel lifecycle and market implementations
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** every PR touching foundation/lifecycle.py, foundation/sessions.py, foundation/market.py or foundation/components.py
**Done check:** grep:foundation/lifecycle.py::CONSOLIDATED-WITH
**Status:** closed

Two implementations of session closure and loop self-improvement (lifecycle.py vs sessions.py / STRANGE-LOOP-1) and two of the market and objection analysis (components.py vs market.py) now exist. Pick one source of truth per concern, move the other's tests and data onto it, delete the duplicate, and add a `CONSOLIDATED-WITH:` marker line to the survivor's docstring.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
